name: Bio Science Animal Health Public Company Limited
summary: Based in Nonthaburi, Thailand, Bio Science Animal Health Public Company Limited (BIS.BK) is a Thai firm engaged in the distribution of animal pharmaceuticals, feed additives, and raw materials. It serves the livestock, aquaculture, and pet sectors across Thailand. The company's comprehensive product range includes bioscience offerings such as antibiotics, various additives, injectable solutions, mold inhibitors, water-soluble formulations, and vaccines. Furthermore, it provides feed additives, disinfectants, amino acids, essential medical supplies, diagnostic instruments, and a full line of animal health and nutrition products. This enterprise was founded in 2004.
